messages:
sara-sales: FYI — Solara (series B fintech) wants a 2-week POC using Redwood Private on their rack + customer HSM. They asked for: fixed POC price, Dedicated capacity for the trial, data residency confirmation, and a short capability matrix. Can eng + legal give quick bullets? cc @raj-eng @sofia-se :eyes:

raj-eng: We can do Private + customer-managed HSM. Caveat: fully air-gapped install requires their infra team to run the installer. Need expected QPS and token latency SLOs to size GPUs. Also: will they want automated backups to S3?

sofia-se: From initial email: peak ~200 reqs/s, embeddings heavy bursts ~120/sec, target soft latency 5–10ms/token (optimistic). They explicitly asked for SOC2 evidence and audit log export.

mike-ml: For 5–10ms/token on typical Llama-variant we should plan A100x2 per replica with optimized kernels + disabled batching for tail latency. Alternative: recommend quantized 4-bit variant for cost/bandwidth tradeoff. I can add model/quant recs for the matrix.

lee-legal: We need to clarify KMS/HSM ownership and access in the POC contract. Preferred: customer-managed keys, Redwood only gets troubleshooting access with explicit consent. I'll draft a short paragraph. No immediate legal blocker. :ok_hand:

raj-eng: Ops checklist draft: network peering, private container registry, installer artifact handoff, HSM credentials (PKCS#11), NTP/clock sync, and a support jumpbox. Example install command for their infra team:

```
redwood-install --mode private --hsm true --kms-provider=customer --registry <private-registry>
```

Also note: backups require an S3-compatible endpoint; if air-gapped they'll need offsite transfer process.

deploy-bot: uploaded file: <https://files.redwood.internal/solara_rfp_email.pdf|solara_rfp_email.pdf>

sara-sales: Thanks. They also asked for a fixed POC price (2 weeks + on-call). Has finance given a bin?

raj-eng: Quick bin: setup/eng runbook + on-site support = $18,000 one-time. Infra + Dedicated reserved for 2 weeks ~ $12,000/week => ~$24,000. Total ~= $42k. Add HSM license / travel if needed. Tagging finance for formal quote. Numbers are rough until we confirm QPS and storage.

sofia-se: I'll assemble a capability matrix (features vs RFP requirements), a 1-page tech note for legal, and a short Q&A doc for the sales deck. ETA: EOD tomorrow. If anyone has one-paragraph blockers, drop them here.

lee-legal: I'll share the KMS/HSM paragraph and sample NDA carveouts by EOD. No red flags so far.

sara-sales: Perfect — once matrix + price bucket are in, I'll push the POC agreement. Please flag any topology or compliance items that would block a 2-week trial. :pray:
